summary: The exact rank-three family A_m=[1] direct_sum J_m/m direct_sum (-J_m/m) has eigenvalues {1,1,-1}; every coordinate cut has cross rank at most two, while every nonsingular physical principal 3x3 block has sigma_min=1/m and every 4x4 principal block is singular. Hence no universal dichotomy of 'uniformly good principal 3/4 block OR rank-three original-coordinate cross cut' follows from the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis. The target itself is not refuted: bank aggregation gives a uniform density bound, and the structural replacement must aggregate independent coordinate banks before reciprocal minor payment.
